title: Watem of Undying
description: Changes the Totem of Undying to the Watem of Undying!
body:
# Watem of Undying v1.0
You have seen people holding water buckets, You have seen people holding totems, But have you seen somebody holding a _Watem?_  Well, you have now!

![Watem](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/18dad9504457c2433ce0f3e47d9c8ba491704326.png)

**This texture pack changes the texture of the Totem of Undying into an amalgamation of a water bucket and a totem.**

I made this pack because one day I was like, "hmm I want a totem texture pack, but I don't want to make it my mc skin, because then it would be unoriginal" And then I thought making it a water bucket would be funny, but then _how am I going to distinguish between totems and water buckets?_ And thus, a masterpiece was invented.

I originally made the pack a year ago, so I used the colors of the gold ingot and the emerald to texture the watem (because I thought it looked too much like bronze than gold). Since then I have came to the conclusion that the colors strayed too far from the vanilla totem look, So I figured that maybe the Watem doesn't have to look like gold cuz what if Illagers used some _mystery metal_ to make the totem? So, today (at the time I'm writing this) I tweaked the colors of the Watem to be more in line with the vanilla totem texture instead of repainting the whole item. Because of this, The colors are _a tiny bit_ off. But since this texture pack drastically changes the shape of the totem, the tiny color change is not very noticeable. _But_, I do plan on fixing the colors in v2.0 .

### Additions

<summary>Additions</summary>

- Changes the Totem of undying's texture to a "Watem" of undying.
- Changes the name "Totem of Undying" into "Watem of Undying"

</details>

To my command pro buddies out there, the item tag (or whatever it is) is still "totem_of_undying" (I don't even think that's changeable).
So an example command would be:
```
/give @s totem_of_undying 1
```
instead of
```
/give @s watem_of_undying 1 (this one is incorrect!)
```


**I hope you enjoy the texture pack :)**
